title: BillingVibesChargeRefundRequest
description: billing.vibes-charge-refund-request@1: the optional body of POST /api/v1/vibes/charges/:id/refund. A refund is always for the whole charge: the Vibes go back from the project's Vibes wallet to the person. reason is recorded on the refund. No amount may be given, because a partial refund is not a Vibes Pay refund.

reason.description: Why the app refunded, for its own and the person's record.
